title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities:**  

Specializes in planning, designing, and developing software systems (e.g., middleware, legacy, mainframe) and applications from concept phase to series production used in local, networked, cloudbased or internet related computer programs. Developers design, code, test, debug, and document program requirements, working with architects, product managers, and endusers in the development and enhancement of applications. Plans, designs, and develops software systems from concept phase to production in local networks or cloud based related computer programs. Codes in relevant languages. CAREER: Applies advanced knowledge of sub\-function typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.  

**Responsibilities may include:*** Managing products, systems and/or projects/processes, and working independently with limited supervision.
* Facing IT function related problems that are sometimes difficult and moderately complex.
* Coaching and reviewing the work of lower\-level professionals.

  

  

**About you** **Qualifications:**

* University Degree and minimum 5 years of prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred:*** Required Qualifications
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
	+ 5\+ years of application development experience using Microsoft technologies.
	+ Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET development.
	+ Advanced SQL Server development and database optimization experience.
* Database Development \& Optimization
	+ Develop reusable generic stored procedures and views that can be reused across multiple functional areas.
	+ Perform performance tuning of stored procedures, functions, queries, and other database objects.
	+ Design and implement Common Table Expressions (CTEs), indexes, temporary tables, and temporal tables to maximize storage and performance.
	+ Analyze and improve database scalability, reliability, and performance.

MOM

Strong expertise in SQL and .NET is mandatory for the role.  

Backend Development Experience  

Candidates should possess 5\+ years of hands\-on backend development experience.  

Strong problem\-solving and application development capabilities are required.  

Frontend Exposure  

Angular/AngularJS exposure is preferred and will be considered an added advantage.

Experience working on system integrations, APIs, and enterprise application integrations is desirable.  

Exposure to Salesforce, finance systems, or Vertex integration environments would be beneficial.  


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being

title: Website Developer Intern
description:
**Job Title:** Website Developer Intern  
**Department:** IT / Digital Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Location:** \[ Aluva ]  
**Experience:** Freshers / Entry\-level candidates

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Website Developer Intern** to join our team. The intern will assist in maintaining, optimizing, and updating our website’s backend to improve performance, functionality, user experience, and overall results.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of web development, website content management, and a willingness to learn backend optimization and technical improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in managing and maintaining the website’s backend.
* Optimize website performance, loading speed, and overall functionality.
* Identify and fix backend issues, bugs, and technical errors.
* **Update and manage website hero images, banners, catalogues, product details, offers, promotions, and other website content.**
* Upload and replace images, videos, documents, and other digital assets as required.
* Ensure website content, pricing, offers, and promotional information are updated accurately and on time.
* Assist in creating and updating website pages, landing pages, and promotional sections.
* Update website plugins, themes, and other backend components as required.
* Assist in improving website structure, navigation, and user experience.
* Support SEO\-related technical improvements, including website speed, mobile responsiveness, and basic on\-page optimization.
* Monitor website performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Assist in database management and website backups where required.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing and creative teams to implement website updates and improvements.
* Test website features and ensure proper functionality across devices and browsers.
* Maintain website security and follow best practices for updates and access management.
* Document changes, updates, and technical issues for future reference.

**Requirements**

* Basic knowledge of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Understanding of website backend systems and content management platforms such as **WordPress or similar CMS**.
* Basic knowledge of website optimization and performance improvement.
* Familiarity with databases, hosting, or server management is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of SEO and website analytics is preferred.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and development tools.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with the team.
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive attitude.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with WordPress backend, plugins, themes, and website customization.
* Basic knowledge of PHP, MySQL, or other backend technologies.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, or website performance tools.
* Understanding of responsive web design and mobile optimization.
* Basic knowledge of Git or version control.
* Interest in improving website performance, functionality, and SEO results.
* **Basic image editing skills using tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or similar software are an advantage.**

**What We Offer**

* Practical experience in website development and backend optimization.
* Opportunity to work on live website projects.
* Guidance and mentorship from the team.
* Exposure to digital marketing, SEO, and website performance improvement.
* A collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity for future employment based on performance and organizational requirements.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Python Developer
description:
About the Role

Elkanio is hiring **Python Developers** to join an established engineering team working on a prestigious **B2C travel experience booking platform**. The product is live, has real users, and is scaling — we're expanding the team to accelerate the roadmap and strengthen delivery.

You'll be working with an experienced engineering team on an existing production platform, contributing to new features, enhancements, integrations, performance improvements, and ongoing platform evolution.

This role is ideal for a developer with around **3 years of hands\-on experience** who is comfortable working with an existing codebase, can understand requirements and translate them into clean technical solutions, and is eager to take increasing ownership of backend modules and features.

What You'll Do

* Develop new features and enhance existing functionality using **Python and Django**.
* Work within an established production codebase, understand existing implementations, and follow established coding and architectural patterns.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain **RESTful APIs** supporting search, booking, payments, user journeys, and other platform capabilities.
* Translate functional requirements into clean, maintainable, and testable technical implementations.
* Work with PostgreSQL and other data stores to implement efficient data models, queries, and data\-access logic.
* Integrate and maintain third\-party services including **payment gateways, mapping services, communication platforms, and travel\-domain APIs**.
* Implement appropriate error handling, validation, logging, and exception management for backend services and integrations.
* Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of application and production issues.
* Investigate bugs, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes rather than only addressing symptoms.
* Write unit tests and contribute to improving test coverage and application quality.
* Participate actively in **code reviews**, technical discussions, and team development practices.
* Work closely with senior developers, product teams, QA, and other stakeholders to deliver features within agreed timelines.
* Monitor application performance and contribute to identifying and resolving basic performance bottlenecks.
* Follow established security, coding, version\-control, and development best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation and keep API and implementation documentation up to date.
* Gradually take ownership of individual features or modules and become the technical point of contact for assigned areas.

What We're Looking For

* Around **3 years of hands\-on software development experience**, with strong experience in backend development.
* Strong programming skills in **Python** with practical experience using **Django**.
* Good understanding of **object\-oriented programming, data structures, exception handling, and clean coding practices**.
* Good understanding of **RESTful API development**, including API design, request/response handling, validation, authentication, and error handling.
* Experience working with **PostgreSQL** and writing efficient SQL queries.
* Working knowledge of **MongoDB or other NoSQL databases** is an advantage.
* Good understanding of database concepts including relationships, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.
* Experience consuming and integrating **third\-party APIs and services**.
* Good understanding of **Git** and collaborative development workflows such as branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Familiarity with **Docker** and basic understanding of containerized application development.
* Basic familiarity with **AWS or other cloud platforms**.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
* Ability to understand and work with an **existing production codebase**.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while knowing when to seek guidance.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

What We Expect at This Level

At around three years of experience, we're looking for someone who can independently handle development tasks while continuing to grow technically.

* Take ownership of assigned features from requirement understanding through development, testing, and release.
* Understand existing implementations before making changes and avoid unnecessary rewrites.
* Follow established architecture and design patterns while contributing suggestions for improvement.
* Identify simple performance, reliability, and maintainability improvements within the areas you work on.
* Participate in technical discussions and learn to evaluate different implementation approaches and trade\-offs.
* Write code that is readable, maintainable, testable, and consistent with team standards.
* Take responsibility for investigating and resolving issues in your assigned areas.
* Learn from senior developers and gradually build capability in **system design, architecture, scalability, and technical decision\-making**.

Bonus Points

* Experience working on **B2C platforms**, particularly travel, hospitality, e\-commerce, or other transaction\-based platforms.
* Experience working with **payment gateways** or payment\-related workflows.
* Experience integrating booking, inventory, travel, or other third\-party APIs.
* Familiarity with **AWS services** and cloud\-based application deployment.
* Experience with background jobs, asynchronous processing, queues, or caching.
* Familiarity with application monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience working on applications with real users and production workloads.
* Exposure to travel technology such as **GDS, NDC, OTA, flight, hotel, or other travel APIs**.

What We Offer

* Compensation aligned with your experience and the industry standard.
* The opportunity to work on a **marquee B2C travel product with real users and real\-world impact**.
* A collaborative, low\-ego engineering environment where you can learn and contribute.
* Exposure to **real\-world production systems, client requirements, third\-party integrations, and technical challenges**.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced developers and gain exposure to **system design, architecture, scalability, and engineering best practices**.
* Direct exposure to client stakeholders and product teams.
* Room to grow technically and take on greater ownership as you develop.
* An opportunity to build expertise in **travel technology, booking platforms, payments, APIs, and large\-scale integrations**.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
